notes: δυνάμεις heads on *mighty* under rule 66's completion test, the corpus spending *power* on δύναμις and never a bare *works*; heading on *works* is the competing reading.
πάλαι heads on *ago* as the meaning-bearing member of *long ago*; *long* remains defensible.
ἄν takes *would* under rule 50; leaving it unrepresented would be the failure that rule names.
